introduction:
◆ Introduction ◆
Finish Fluffy Across the Blue with an unsatisfactory ending? Sorry, but the greatest and most responsible comic artist, Blurry_QR_Colt, could never do such a thing. In fact, she's even going to draw a gourmet theatrical version! She has left behind an inheritance waiting to be claimed. To get your hands on it, you'll have to first finish this masterpiece. However, "drawing" comics isn't as simple as you think...

◆ Event Rules ◆
● At the invitation of Blurry_QR_Colt, the Trailblazer will enter the comic world and run "God's Dessert Shop" to complete the overdue bonus chapter pages for Fluffy Across the Blue.
● The Trailblazer must prepare desserts according to orders in a timely manner to satisfy customers and earn revenue for the shop.
● Throughout the process, the Trailblazer will gradually upgrade shop equipment, unlock new ingredients and desserts, and advance the manuscript's progress.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Complete each episode's Crunch Goals to boost your Crunch Progress and earn permanent rewards.

◆ Limited-time Rewards ◆
Complete limited-time missions during the event period to obtain limited-time rewards.

◆ Event Reminder ◆
● After the "The Fluffy Movie: Overheated" limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards, but they can still visit the Starfroster map to experience the event and obtain permanent rewards.
